title: VC4Tile M5 verifier mechanism smoke specification

verifications.description: M5 feature-gate aliases resolve to the new verifier mechanisms.
Surface/core contract accepts a core file with no surface, producer, scf, or index residue.

steps.name: write-core

verifications.description: Copy-plan contract accepts a concrete TMU-backed global-to-register plan and matching core op evidence.

steps.name: write-plan
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import json
root = Path('.vc4_auto/vc4tile_m5/mechanism_smoke/copy_plan')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root / 'core.vc4tile.mlir').write_text('module {
  vc4tile.kernel @copy() {
    %ld = vc4tile.masked_load_global %base, %offs, %mask {elem_bytes = 4 : i32} : i32, vector<16xi32>, vector<16xi1> -> vector<16xi32>
    vc4tile.return
  }
}
', encoding='utf-8')
(root / 'copy-plan.json').write_text(json.dumps({'copies': [{'name': 'load_x', 'src': 'global', 'dst': 'register', 'method': 'tmu'}]}, indent=2) + '
', encoding='utf-8')
print('copy-plan-ok')

verifications.description: Precision policy contract enforces 32-bit markers and deterministic unsupported sub-32 diagnostics.

steps.name: write-policy
argv:
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('.vc4_auto/vc4tile_m5/mechanism_smoke/precision')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root / 'precision-policy.txt').write_text('storage_type expressed_type accumulator_type precision exact_32 i32 u32 f32 vector<16xi32> vector<16xf32>\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('precision-policy-ok')

invalid_cases.name: unsupported-sub32-diagnostic
argv:
import sys
sys.stderr.write('unsupported sub32 precision\n')
raise SystemExit(7)

verifications.description: Pipeline contract verifies M5 runner pass ordering and preserved intermediate files.

steps.name: write-runner-and-intermediates
argv:
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('.vc4_auto/vc4tile_m5/mechanism_smoke/pipeline')
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
script = '\n'.join(['vc4-opt input.vc4tile.mlir --canonicalize-vc4tile-surface -o surface.vc4tile.mlir','vc4-opt surface.vc4tile.mlir --plan-vc4tile-copies -o planned.vc4tile.mlir','vc4-opt planned.vc4tile.mlir --legalize-vc4tile-core-cfg -o core.vc4tile.mlir','vc4-opt core.vc4tile.mlir --verify-vc4tile-core -o core.vc4tile.mlir','vc4-opt core.vc4tile.mlir --convert-vc4tile-to-ssavc4 -o lowered.ssavc4.mlir','vc4-opt lowered.ssavc4.mlir --convert-ssavc4-to-vc4 -o scheduled.vc4.mlir','vc4-codegen scheduled.vc4.mlir --emit-bundle bundle']) + '\n'
(root / 'run_vc4tile_candidate_codegen_test.sh').write_text(script, encoding='utf-8')
for name in ['input.vc4tile.mlir','surface.vc4tile.mlir','planned.vc4tile.mlir','core.vc4tile.mlir','lowered.ssavc4.mlir','scheduled.vc4.mlir']:
    (root / name).write_text('module {}\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('pipeline-ok')
